title: A measurement noise scaling law for cellular representation learning
zh_title: 细胞表征学习的测量噪声缩放定律
summary: 以辅助信号互信息衡量表征模型表现，拟合2000余个模型，覆盖基因表达、序列与图像，发现性能随噪声呈对数缩放。
key_points: 拟合超过2000个表征学习模型
覆盖基因表达、序列、图像三种模态
噪声缩放遵循对数规律并有理论推导
reason: 细胞基础模型缩放规律，有新意，但属方法研究
abstract: Large genomic and imaging datasets can be used to train models that learn meaningful representations of cellular systems. Across domains, model performance improves predictably with dataset size and compute budget, providing a basis for allocating data and computation. Scientific data, however, are also limited by noise arising from factors such as molecular undersampling, sequencing errors and image resolution. Here we introduce mutual information with auxiliary signals as a metric of representation model performance and study its scaling with noise. By fitting more than 2,000 representation learning models across three data modalities (gene expression, sequence and image data), we show that noise defines a distinct axis along which performance improves. Noise scaling follows a logarithmic law. We derive the law from a model of noise propagation, and use it to define noise sensitivity and model capacity as benchmarking metrics. We show that protein-sequence representations tolerate error rates in modern sequencing data, whereas single-cell transcriptomic models remain noise limited at current measurement signal-to-noise ratio levels. Within transcriptomic cell-state representation learning models, we find that transformer-based models are more noise robust but less performant than variational autoencoders. Noise scaling metrics may support future model evaluation and experimental design.
zh_abstract: 大型基因组和影像数据集可用于训练能够学习细胞系统有意义表征的模型。在各个领域中，模型性能均随数据集规模和计算预算而可预测地提升，这为数据和计算资源的分配提供了依据。然而，科学数据同样受到噪声的限制，噪声来源包括分子欠采样、测序错误和图像分辨率等因素。在此，我们提出以与辅助信号的互信息作为表征模型性能的指标，并研究其随噪声的缩放规律。通过在三种数据模态（基因表达、序列和图像数据）上拟合 2,000 多个表征学习模型，我们表明噪声定义了一条性能得以提升的独立轴线。噪声缩放遵循对数规律。我们从噪声传播模型推导出该规律，并据此定义噪声敏感性和模型容量，作为基准评测指标。我们表明，蛋白质序列表征可耐受现代测序数据中的错误率，而单细胞转录组模型在当前测量信噪比水平下仍受噪声限制。在转录组细胞状态表征学习模型中，我们发现基于 Transformer 的模型噪声鲁棒性更强，但性能不及变分自编码器。噪声缩放指标可能有助于未来的模型评估和实验设计。

abstract: The silicon microelectrode ‘Utah’ array has enabled people with paralysis to control computer cursors, operate prosthetic limbs and communicate using high-performance brain–computer interfaces. However, reports so far have typically been limited to one or two individuals, with no systematic assessment of array longevity, decoding accuracy and day-to-day stability. Here we present a comprehensive 20-year evaluation of neural data from the BrainGate clinical trials, spanning 2,289 recording sessions, 20 arrays and 14 participants. On average, arrays successfully recorded neural spiking waveforms on 35.6% of electrodes, with a modest 7 percentage point decline over the recording period (up to 7.3 years). Using a ‘decoding signal-to-noise ratio’ (dSNR) metric, we found that 11 of 14 arrays provided meaningful movement decoding throughout participation (median dSNR >1), with three achieving >70% accuracy compared with able-bodied mouse control. We also found that dSNR increased approximately logarithmically with the number of electrodes, providing a pathway for scaling performance. While longevity exceeded previous nonhuman primate studies, achieving peak performance consistently may require further improvements.

title: Large Language Model Performance in Structured Data Extraction From Neurosurgical Electronic Health Records: Comparative Benchmark Study.
zh_title: 神经外科电子病历结构化信息提取：19个大模型对比基准
summary: 前瞻性单中心队列纳入172例捷克语神经外科病历，以35个数据点为真值，比较19个LLM的结构化提取表现。
key_points: 172例患者，35个数据点双人共识标注
19个LLM使用统一JSON提示
主要结局为总体准确率
reason: 单中心规范基准，无外部验证，样本中等
abstract: [JMIR formative research] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to extract information from electronic health records (EHRs). Given the rapid pace of LLM development, robust scenario-specific benchmarks are essential to evaluate clinical usefulness and support safe deployment. This study aimed to compare contemporary LLMs for structured data extraction from real neurosurgical EHRs written in Czech. In a prospective single-center cohort, 172 hospitalized patients provided informed consent for the use of anonymized EHRs. For each patient, predefined records were collected and concatenated. Ground truth for 35 data points was established by dual extraction with consensus. A standardized prompt requesting JSON output was submitted to 19 LLMs. The primary outcome was overall accuracy; secondary outcomes were category-level accuracy and the proportion of complete machine-readable outputs. A total of 6264 documents were collected (median 33, IQR 25-41 per patient). Ground truth was established with 92.6% initial interrater agreement before consensus. Several models produced complete JSON outputs for 100% of cases (Claude 4.1 Opus, Grok 4, and Gemini 2.5 Flash); GPT-4.1 (DeepSearch) and GPT-5 completed 99.4%. The highest accuracy was achieved by GPT-4.1 (87.6%), followed by GPT-4.5 (85.6%), Claude 4.1 (84.8%), and Grok 4 (84.2%). Accuracy declined by data type: binary (up to 95%), numeric (~89%), multiple-choice (~75%), and short text (~78%). Current LLMs can reliably extract structured clinical information from full, non-English EHRs, while older or smaller models show major limitations. A hybrid workflow-automated extraction with targeted validation-appears practical for research use.
zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于从电子健康记录（EHR）中提取信息。鉴于LLM发展迅速，需要稳健的、针对特定场景的基准来评估其临床实用性并支持安全部署。本研究旨在比较当代LLM对以捷克语书写的真实神经外科EHR进行结构化数据提取的表现。在一项前瞻性单中心队列中，172名住院患者对使用匿名化EHR知情同意。对每名患者，收集并拼接预先设定的记录。35个数据点的金标准通过双人提取并达成共识确定。向19个LLM提交要求输出JSON的标准化提示。主要结局为总体准确率；次要结局为类别层面的准确率及完整机器可读输出的比例。共收集6264份文档（每名患者中位数33份，IQR 25-41）。金标准在共识前的初始评估者间一致性为92.6%。若干模型对100%的病例生成了完整的JSON输出（Claude 4.1 Opus、Grok 4和Gemini 2.5 Flash）；GPT-4.1（DeepSearch）和GPT-5完成率为99.4%。准确率最高的是GPT-4.1（87.6%），其次为GPT-4.5（85.6%）、Claude 4.1（84.8%）和Grok 4（84.2%）。准确率随数据类型而下降：二元型（最高95%）、数值型（约89%）、多选型（约75%）和短文本型（约78%）。当前LLM能够从完整的非英语EHR中可靠地提取结构化临床信息，而较旧或较小的模型则存在明显局限。自动化提取加针对性验证的混合工作流程对于研究用途似乎切实可行。

title: Learning the Malignant Transformation of Lung Adenocarcinoma Cells Using Explainable AI
zh_title: 可解释AI学习肺腺癌细胞恶性转化
summary: 基于227例患者42万余肿瘤细胞snRNA-seq，构建全局肿瘤时间GTT衡量细胞进展，预后C-index 0.60，并在两个外部队列验证（预印本）。
key_points: 227例患者、422,727个肿瘤细胞
GTT与临床病理及空间特征一致
预后C-index 0.60，外部队列验证
reason: 大规模单细胞数据含外部验证，但预后效能中等且为预印本
abstract: Tumor evolution in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) drives drug resistance and disease progression, yet the cellular transitions underlying the malignant transformation of cells remain poorly understood. Comparing this progression of cancer cells across patients is challenging owing to substantial inter-patient cell heterogeneity. Here, based on single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) data of 227 patients with LUAD including 422,727 tumor cells, we conducted a comprehensive investigation of tumor cell progression and developed Global Tumor Time (GTT), a continuous measure of tumor cell progression across patients. GTT provided a scalable and biologically meaningful metric of tumor progression that aligned with clinicopathological, transcriptomic and spatial characteristics of malignancy and demonstrated robust prognostic performance (C-index = 0.60), which was further validated in two external datasets comprising snRNA-seq (C-index = 0.66) and bulk RNA sequencing (C-index = 0.61). Using explainable AI to investigate the molecular correlates of GTT, we identified two distinct transcriptional programs associated with early and late progression states. These findings establish a scalable and interpretable framework for reconstructing malignant cell transformation across patients and allow for investigating the biology of tumor progression at single-cell resolution.

title: RIPPLE: learning nucleotide relations in an RNA foundation model
zh_title: RIPPLE：在RNA基础模型中学习核苷酸关系
summary: RIPPLE是在3240万条RNA序列上预训练的RNA基础模型，用成对预测效用引导学习核苷酸关系，推理时无需结构输入。

reason: 新方法的基础模型预印本，有下游对比，未经评审
abstract: RNA function depends on interactions between nucleotides that can be widely separated in sequence, yet capturing these relationships remains challenging for RNA language models. Existing approaches primarily learn nucleotide relationships implicitly from individual nucleotide reconstruction or rely on external structural information to model nucleotide interactions. Here we introduce RIPPLE, an RNA foundation model that learns to identify and represent sparse, predictively useful nucleotide relationships directly from sequence. Pretrained on 32.4 million RNA sequences, RIPPLE uses pairwise predictive utility to guide relational learning, transferring training-time supervision into a sequence-only model without requiring structural inputs at inference. RIPPLE improves overall performance across five downstream tasks spanning RNA family classification, ribosome loading prediction, secondary-structure prediction, three-dimensional contact prediction, and splice-site recognition. Mechanistic analyses further show that utility-guided learning improves the recovery of informative interactions and enhances the transferability of learned RNA representations.

abstract: [Journal of personalized medicine] Heart failure affects more than 64 million people worldwide and remains associated with high mortality and recurrent hospitalisation. Artificial intelligence (AI), including large language models (LLMs), is being evaluated across the care pathway, but evidence maturity varies by task. The aim of this narrative review was to appraise direct evidence for LLM applications in heart failure, distinguish it from supporting evidence for other AI methods and propose a risk-based framework for clinical evaluation and governance. The strongest direct LLM evidence concerns electronic health record extraction, document drafting, patient information and clinical trial endpoint adjudication. A small, randomised pilot evaluated supervised generative-AI-guided optimisation of guideline-directed medical therapy. Prospective case-finding and monitoring evidence largely concerns non-LLM AI. For conversational AI telemonitoring (a natural language interface with rule-based alerting), prospective evidence was limited to a single non-randomised controlled pilot. Performance depends on task definition, data completeness, human review and workflow adoption. Overall, LLMs can support clearly defined, supervised heart failure tasks, but current evidence does not justify autonomous high-stakes care. The evidence base is expanding but predominantly retrospective. Prospective trials, disease-specific benchmarks, equity assessment and regulatory engagement are prerequisites for safe clinical translation. Human oversight remains essential across all current-generation applications.

abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Creatinine, estimated glomerular filtration rate and histology detect kidney disease late and say little about the molecular heterogeneity driving progression. Artificial intelligence can extract molecular features from biofluid omics; digitised biopsies and retinal images supply proxy readouts, not molecular measurements. In this review we grouped the literature by histopathology, multi-omics, foundation models and noninvasive systems and checked each result against its cohort, endpoint and validation setting. Reported performance is often high, but most results come from retrospective single-cohort evaluations; external and prospective validation are uncommon, and we found no study among those reviewed showing improved patient outcomes. High discrimination therefore establishes technical performance only; clinical utility and patient benefit remain untested. The evidence to date supports feasibility, not benefit, and the weakness lies in evaluation design rather than model architecture. The evidence so far establishes feasibility, not benefit. Until prospective studies on shared external cohorts are available, these tools are best used to augment existing diagnostic practice, with patient outcomes as the measure of success.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving from stand-alone accuracy studies to prospective deployment across breast screening, risk prediction, multimodal diagnosis, treatment response, and workflow support. The goal of this narrative review is to determine which AI applications have demonstrated clinical benefit, which remain technically promising, and what safeguards are required for implementation. We synthesize randomized trials, prospective cohorts, real-world implementations, external validations, systematic reviews, and guidance identified in PubMed/MEDLINE and Scopus through 30 June 2026. In screening, AI-supported mammography can increase cancer detection and reduce reading workload, but effects depend on whether AI is used as concurrent support, an independent reader, triage, or partial autonomy; autonomous workflows may shift work and cost downstream through additional recalls. MASAI met its prespecified noninferiority criterion for interval cancer, but this should not be interpreted as proof of equivalence or mortality benefit. Image-based risk models often discriminate better than density or conventional clinical models, although prospective benefit from AI-guided allocation to supplemental imaging has not yet been demonstrated. Evidence for contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM), MRI, ultrasound, radiomics, and multimodal models is less mature and limited by external validation, domain shift, missing data, operator dependence, and uncertain incremental value beyond clinicopathological factors. Ungrounded large language models and opaque foundation models are not suitable for autonomous clinical advice. Current evidence therefore supports controlled, task-specific integration rather than radiologist replacement; real clinical benefit depends on governance of the whole AI-enabled pathway, including local validation, human factors, downstream resource use, statistical stopping rules, and fallback procedures.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）正从独立的准确性研究走向乳腺筛查、风险预测、多模态诊断、治疗反应评估及工作流程支持等方面的前瞻性应用。本叙述性综述旨在明确哪些AI应用已显示出临床获益，哪些在技术上仍具前景，以及实施时需要哪些保障措施。我们综合了截至2026年6月30日在PubMed/MEDLINE和Scopus中检索到的随机试验、前瞻性队列研究、真实世界应用、外部验证、系统评价及指南。在筛查方面，AI辅助乳腺X线摄影可提高癌症检出率并减少阅片工作量，但其效果取决于AI是作为同步辅助、独立阅片者、分诊工具还是部分自主使用；自主工作流程可能因额外召回而将工作量和成本转移至下游。MASAI研究达到了其预先设定的间期癌非劣效性标准，但这不应被解读为等效性或死亡率获益的证据。基于影像的风险模型通常比乳腺密度或传统临床模型具有更好的区分能力，但AI引导的补充影像检查分配所带来的前瞻性获益尚未得到证实。对比增强乳腺X线摄影（CEM）、MRI、超声、影像组学及多模态模型的证据尚不成熟，并受限于外部验证不足、领域偏移、数据缺失、操作者依赖性，以及在临床病理因素之外的增量价值不确定。缺乏依据（未接地）的大语言模型和不透明的基础模型不适合用于自主的临床建议。因此，现有证据支持受控的、针对特定任务的整合，而非取代放射科医师；真实的临床获益取决于对整个AI赋能路径的管理，包括本地验证、人因因素、下游资源使用、统计停止规则以及后备程序。

title: Advances in PET/CT Segmentation for Lymphoma: Bridging Classical Approaches With Artificial Intelligence.

abstract: [Molecular imaging] Accurate segmentation of metabolically active lymphoma on whole-body 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (18F-FDG PET/CT) is important for prognosis and treatment planning. Conventional methods show substantial variability, whereas deep learning (DL) offers improved automation but limited multicenter generalizability. To compare classical and AI-based segmentation approaches and assess their clinical performance, reproducibility, and potential for precision oncology. A structured search of PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Google Scholar (1990-2025) identified studies on lymphoma segmentation using manual, threshold-based, region-growing, clustering, atlas-based, or DL methods. Outcomes included Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), reproducibility, and prognostic relevance. A total of 73 studies were included in the final analysis. Threshold-based methods were simple but inconsistent. Region-based approaches achieved DSCs of approximately 0.80-0.84, while clustering methods reached about 0.87. Atlas-based techniques improved physiologic uptake exclusion but often required expert review. DL models, particularly U-Net and V-Net variants, achieved DSCs of approximately 0.75-0.88 and approached expert-level performance. Hybrid PET/CT and longitudinal models further improved segmentation accuracy. AI-based segmentation offers scalable and reproducible lymphoma burden assessment. Key challenges remain multicenter generalizability, small-lesion detection, and explainability, highlighting the need for harmonized datasets and clinically oriented validation.
zh_abstract: [Molecular imaging] 在全身18F-氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描/计算机断层扫描（18F-FDG PET/CT）上准确分割代谢活跃的淋巴瘤，对预后判断和治疗规划十分重要。传统方法存在较大变异性，而深度学习（DL）可提高自动化程度，但多中心泛化能力有限。目的：比较经典与基于AI的分割方法，并评估其临床性能、可重复性及在精准肿瘤学中的潜力。通过对PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、EMBASE和Google Scholar（1990–2025年）的结构化检索，纳入了使用手动、阈值法、区域生长、聚类、基于图谱或DL方法进行淋巴瘤分割的研究。结局指标包括Dice相似系数（DSC）、可重复性和预后相关性。最终分析共纳入73项研究。基于阈值的方法简单但结果不一致。基于区域的方法DSC约为0.80–0.84，聚类方法约为0.87。基于图谱的技术改善了对生理性摄取的排除，但常需专家复核。DL模型，尤其是U-Net和V-Net变体，DSC约为0.75–0.88，接近专家水平。PET/CT混合模型和纵向模型进一步提高了分割准确性。基于AI的分割可实现可扩展且可重复的淋巴瘤负荷评估。多中心泛化能力、小病灶检出和可解释性仍是主要挑战，凸显了需要统一的数据集和以临床为导向的验证。

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and Immunotherapy: A Review of the Emerging Uses and Current Challenges.
source: PubMed · International journal of molecular sciences
zh_title: AI 在非小细胞肺癌免疫治疗中的应用与挑战综述
summary: 叙述性综述，梳理病理、液体活检、影像及多模态数据中 AI 预测免疫治疗反应的应用与挑战。
key_points: PD-L1 等现有生物标志物预测能力有限
涵盖病理、液体活检、影像与多模态
评估证据并讨论当前挑战
reason: 叙述性综述，主题契合治疗反应预测，综述上限内
abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide despite major therapeutic advances, including immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Although a subset of patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) experiences durable long-term responses, currently available predictive biomarkers, including programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) expression, have limited ability to reliably distinguish responders from non-responders. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have emerged as powerful approaches for extracting clinically meaningful patterns from complex, high-dimensional datasets spanning pathology, liquid biopsy, imaging, and integrated multimodal data. This narrative review examines current applications of AI in NSCLC immunotherapy across these complementary data modalities and evaluates the evidence supporting their clinical translation. Particular attention is given to the methodological limitations of existing studies and to the emerging shift from single-modality biomarkers toward dynamic and multimodal prediction. Although AI-based approaches show potential to complement established biomarkers, limitations in validation, generalizability, and prospective evidence currently restrict their clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 尽管包括免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）在内的治疗取得重大进展，肺癌仍是全球癌症相关死亡的首要原因。虽然一部分晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者可获得持久的长期缓解，但包括程序性死亡配体-1（PD-L1）表达在内的现有预测性生物标志物，可靠区分应答者与非应答者的能力有限。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）已成为从涵盖病理、液体活检、影像及整合多模态数据的复杂高维数据集中提取具有临床意义模式的有力方法。本叙述性综述考察了AI在NSCLC免疫治疗中跨这些互补数据模态的现有应用，并评估支持其临床转化的证据。文中特别关注现有研究的方法学局限，以及从单一模态生物标志物向动态和多模态预测转变的新趋势。尽管基于AI的方法显示出补充既有生物标志物的潜力，但在验证、泛化能力和前瞻性证据方面的不足目前限制了其临床应用。

title: The Translation Gap in Artificial Intelligence-Based Renal Mass Characterization: A Narrative Review.
zh_title: AI肾脏肿块characterization的转化鸿沟：叙述综述
summary: 综述指出AI肾脏肿块定性模型虽在多中心及部分前瞻测试集表现良好，但独立验证、对管理或结局影响及监管证据仍有限。
key_points: 验证多基于切除并病理确诊的肿块，小病灶代表不足
RenalCLIP、MPANet等多中心模型仍为回顾性
四项回顾性读者实验显示辅助或提升准确性，未测量结局
reason: 综述上限6档；含读者研究与转化证据评述
abstract: [Cancers] Artificial intelligence (AI) models for solid renal mass characterization show promising discrimination in multicenter and some prospective test sets, yet little published evidence supports their routine clinical use. We examine four translation gaps. Independent, representative validation remains limited, and most studies use resected, pathologically confirmed masses, underrepresenting small indeterminate lesions managed by biopsy or surveillance. Recent multicenter models, including RenalCLIP and MPANet, broadened tasks and external testing but remain retrospective. Four retrospective reader experiments suggest that AI assistance can improve readers' accuracy or consistency, but no study identified measured effects on management or patient outcomes. Regulatory evidence is limited: one renal tool reported by its manufacturer as certified under the European Union Medical Device Regulation rests on a single-center retrospective reader study of detection and reporting, and no characterization device was identified in the U.S. Food and Drug Administration AI-enabled device list. The 2026 European Association of Urology guidelines discuss AI as an emerging technology without a graded recommendation. Cost, information technology integration, trust, and interpretability further restrict adoption. We propose a roadmap built around one intended use, the small indeterminate solid mass considered for biopsy or surveillance, with prespecified thresholds, target-specific reference standards, and paired management and safety endpoints.

title: BYSTER: multimodal graph learning resolves bystander versus tumor-specific T cell states in the tumor immune microenvironment
zh_title: BYSTER：多模态图学习区分旁观者与肿瘤特异性T细胞
summary: 预印本提出异质图神经网络BYSTER，整合转录与配对TCR表示，在三个数据集上AUROC为0.729至0.920，优于单模态与常规多模态基线。
key_points: 跨模态消息传递，在metacell/metaTCR层面整合
三个数据集平均AUROC 0.729–0.920
消融实验支持跨模态传递的贡献
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比，证据有限；单细胞肿瘤免疫方向
abstract: Bystander T cells infiltrate tumors without recognizing tumor antigens and constitute a substantial component of the tumor microenvironment. Whether they are passive residents or active participants in antitumor immunity, and how they influence immunotherapy response, remains poorly understood, largely because transcriptional states and T-cell receptor (TCR) sequences alone do not reliably resolve antigen specificity. Here, we developed BYSTER, a heterogeneous graph neural network that integrates transcriptional representations with paired TCR representations through cross-modal message passing at metacell and metaTCR resolution. Across three datasets with distinct definitions of tumor specificity, BYSTER achieved mean AUROCs of 0.729 to 0.920, outperforming unimodal and conventional multimodal baselines, and ablation analyses confirmed the contribution of cross-modal message passing. Application to lung and pancreatic cancer cohorts revealed distinct biological characteristics of the two predicted populations. Bystander T cells were enriched for naive and memory subsets and MAIT-like cells expressing SLC4A10, and exhibited inflammatory and cellular stress-associated programs, including TNF signaling via NF-{kappa}B and hypoxia. Notably, these transcriptional patterns were consistent across lung and pancreatic cancers, with tumor-specific T cells showing enrichment of cell cycle and proliferation-associated programs in both cancer types. Spatial analyses further revealed distinct inferred communication patterns, with bystander T cells showing associations with inflammatory ligand-receptor interactions involving myeloid populations. Responders to immunotherapy contributed a larger proportion of the predicted bystander compartment, suggesting an association between bystander T-cell abundance and an immune-responsive microenvironment. BYSTER thus links predicted T-cell antigen specificity to transcriptional states, spatial organization and clinical response, highlighting the potential importance of bystander T cells in tumor immunity.
zh_abstract: 旁观者T细胞浸润肿瘤但不识别肿瘤抗原，是肿瘤微环境的重要组成部分。它们究竟是被动的驻留者还是抗肿瘤免疫的积极参与者，以及如何影响免疫治疗应答，目前仍知之甚少，主要原因在于仅凭转录状态和T细胞受体（TCR）序列无法可靠地解析抗原特异性。在此，我们开发了BYSTER，这是一种异质图神经网络，通过在metacell和metaTCR分辨率上进行跨模态消息传递，整合转录表征与配对TCR表征。在三个对肿瘤特异性定义不同的数据集中，BYSTER的平均AUROC为0.729至0.920，优于单模态和传统多模态基线，消融分析证实了跨模态消息传递的贡献。将其应用于肺癌和胰腺癌队列，揭示了两类预测群体具有不同的生物学特征。旁观者T细胞富集于初始（naive）和记忆亚群以及表达SLC4A10的MAIT样细胞，并表现出炎症和细胞应激相关程序，包括通过NF-κB的TNF信号通路和缺氧。值得注意的是，这些转录模式在肺癌和胰腺癌中一致，而肿瘤特异性T细胞在两种癌症中均表现为细胞周期和增殖相关程序的富集。空间分析进一步揭示了不同的推断通讯模式，旁观者T细胞与涉及髓系细胞群的炎症性配体-受体相互作用相关。免疫治疗应答者在预测的旁观者细胞部分中占比更大，提示旁观者T细胞丰度与免疫应答性微环境之间存在关联。因此，BYSTER将预测的T细胞抗原特异性与转录状态、空间组织和临床应答联系起来，凸显了旁观者T细胞在肿瘤免疫中的潜在重要性。

title: Auditable AI agents for verifiable end-to-end scientific analysis
zh_title: 面向可验证端到端科学分析的可审计AI智能体
summary: 预印本提出以可审计性为核心的科学自动化范式，并在病毒进化分析中实现EvoTrace智能体。
key_points: 四项原则：知识落地、有界执行、证据支撑、独立验证
整理13条原则、236个陷阱、50个分析单元
验证其中47项并构成六层体系
reason: AI for scientific discovery方向，新意明确但证据有限
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are evolving from research assistants into end-to-end executors, yet their capacity to generate conclusions at scale outpaces rigorous verification. Here we introduce an auditability-centred paradigm for scientific automation, wherein trust relies not on generative capability or self-evaluation, but on whether claims can be independently traced to primary evidence, reviewed and corrected. Moving beyond post-hoc checks, we embed verification throughout the research lifecycle via four principles: grounded knowledge, bounded execution, evidence-backed results and independent verification. We instantiate this paradigm in EvoTrace for viral evolutionary analysis. Distilling peer-review critiques and methodological literature, we curated 13 principles, 236 pitfalls and 50 analytical units - validating 47 across a six-tier hierarchy - to encode methodological limits as executable constraints. Across simulated benchmarks, six viral datasets and an end-to-end Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) study, claim-evidence auditing compiled evidence packages for all 233 analyses (flagging 26 incomplete evidentiary chains), while independent numerical and figure audits rectified 17 flaws, including three blocker-level errors. For CCHFV, EvoTrace intercepted a data-contradictory claim, recalibrating 'no reassortment candidates' to 'no high-confidence candidates'. By co-delivering verification evidence, auditable automation shifts AI-driven science from autonomous generation to continuous scrutiny and correction.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）智能体正从研究助手演变为端到端执行者，但其大规模生成结论的能力超过了严格验证的速度。在此我们提出一种以可审计性为核心的科学自动化范式：信任并不依赖于生成能力或自我评估，而取决于结论能否被独立追溯到原始证据、接受审查并得到纠正。我们不再局限于事后检查，而是通过四项原则将验证贯穿整个研究生命周期：有据可依的知识、有界的执行、有证据支持的结果和独立验证。我们在用于病毒进化分析的EvoTrace中实现了这一范式。通过提炼同行评审意见和方法学文献，我们整理出13项原则、236个陷阱和50个分析单元（其中47个在六层级体系中经过验证），将方法学局限编码为可执行的约束。在模拟基准、六个病毒数据集以及一项端到端克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒（CCHFV）研究中，结论-证据审计为全部233项分析编制了证据包（标记出26条不完整的证据链），而独立的数值与图表审计纠正了17处缺陷，其中包括三处阻断级错误。在CCHFV研究中，EvoTrace拦截了一条与数据相矛盾的结论，将“无重配候选”重新校准为“无高置信度候选”。通过同步提供验证证据，可审计自动化使AI驱动的科学从自主生成转向持续的审查与纠正。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Auditory Electrophysiological Biomarkers in Alzheimer's Disease and Hearing Loss: A Critical Narrative Review.
zh_title: AI用于阿尔茨海默病与听力损失听觉电生理标志物：批判性叙述综述
summary: 该叙述综述讨论AI如何利用EEG、ERP、ABR等听觉电生理信号，作为阿尔茨海默病与听力损失的早期生物标志物。
key_points: 关注AD长期临床前期与早期标志物需求
涉及EEG、ERP、AECP、ABR、耳蜗微音等信号
听力损失被视为与认知衰退和痴呆风险相关的因素
reason: 叙述综述，上限6档；痴呆方向略加分但证据有限
abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with a long preclinical phase, making early biomarker discovery essential for timely diagnosis, risk stratification, and intervention. Hearing loss has increasingly been recognized as a clinically important and potentially modifiable factor associated with cognitive decline and dementia risk. Beyond peripheral auditory impairment, accumulating evidence suggests that central auditory dysfunction, altered auditory processing, and electrophysiological abnormalities may emerge during the course of AD and related cognitive disorders. Auditory electrophysiological signals, including electroencephalography (EEG), auditory event-related potentials (ERP), auditory evoked cortical potentials (AECP), auditory brainstem response (ABR) recordings, cochlear microphonics (CM), and distortion product otoacoustic emission (DPOAE) measures, provide objective and repeatable measurements of peripheral and central auditory pathway function. However, conventional analysis based on peak latency, amplitude, spectral power, and manually engineered features may not fully capture subtle disease-related alterations distributed across time, frequency, and waveform morphology. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities to extract high-dimensional and physiologically informative representations from auditory and neural signals. Machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), self-supervised learning (SSL), explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), and multimodal modeling can support data-driven biomarker discovery, especially in settings where labeled datasets are limited and electrophysiological changes are subtle. This critical narrative review synthesizes current knowledge at the intersection of hearing loss, AD, auditory electrophysiology, and AI. We discuss traditional signal processing, supervised ML, deep neural networks, self-supervised representation learning, explainable models, and multimodal integration strategies. We also identify major methodological limitations, including small sample sizes, heterogeneous acquisition protocols, insufficient external validation, limited interpretability, data leakage risks, and challenges in translating animal-model findings to human disease. Finally, we propose future directions for trustworthy, interpretable, and multimodal AI systems capable of advancing auditory electrophysiological biomarkers for AD and hearing-related neurodegeneration.
zh_abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，具有较长的临床前期，因此早期生物标志物的发现对于及时诊断、风险分层和干预至关重要。听力损失日益被认为是与认知下降和痴呆风险相关的、具有重要临床意义且可能可干预的因素。除外周听觉损害外，越来越多的证据表明，中枢听觉功能障碍、听觉处理改变以及电生理异常可能在 AD 及相关认知障碍的病程中出现。听觉电生理信号，包括脑电图（EEG）、听觉事件相关电位（ERP）、听觉诱发皮层电位（AECP）、听性脑干反应（ABR）记录、耳蜗微音电位（CM）以及畸变产物耳声发射（DPOAE）测量，可对外周和中枢听觉通路功能提供客观且可重复的测量。然而，基于峰潜伏期、波幅、频谱功率及人工设计特征的传统分析，可能无法充分捕捉分布于时间、频率和波形形态中的细微疾病相关改变。人工智能（AI）为从听觉和神经信号中提取高维且具有生理学信息的表征提供了新的机会。机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）、自监督学习（SSL）、可解释人工智能（XAI）和多模态建模可支持数据驱动的生物标志物发现，尤其是在标注数据集有限且电生理变化细微的情况下。本篇批判性叙述性综述综合了听力损失、AD、听觉电生理学与 AI 交叉领域的现有知识。我们讨论了传统信号处理、监督式机器学习、深度神经网络、自监督表征学习、可解释模型以及多模态整合策略。我们还指出了主要的方法学局限，包括样本量小、采集方案异质、外部验证不足、可解释性有限、数据泄漏风险，以及将动物模型研究结果转化到人类疾病所面临的挑战。最后，我们提出了未来的发展方向，即构建可信、可解释的多模态 AI 系统，以推进用于 AD 及听力相关神经退行性变的听觉电生理生物标志物。

title: Deep Learning-Assisted COF-Based Hydrogel Platform for Point-of-Care Monitoring and Photothermal Treatment of Infected Wounds.
zh_title: 深度学习辅助COF水凝胶用于感染伤口监测与光热治疗
summary: 研究构建含pH比色传感与无金属COF-102光热单元的水凝胶平台，并引入CNN分析比色图像，用于糖尿病感染伤口的即时监测与治疗。
key_points: 水凝胶共价掺入MA-PR实现pH比色传感
COF-102无需金属离子即可光热转换
引入CNN分析水凝胶比色信息
reason: 材料为主的小规模平台研究，AI仅为辅助，无临床验证，属增量档
abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] Non-real-time monitoring in diabetic wound infections often leads to treatment delays, exacerbating tissue damage and impairing healing. Herein, this study develops a deep learning-assisted covalent organic framework (COF)-based wound management platform for point-of-care pH monitoring and photothermal therapy. The platform is constructed using a multifunctional hydrogel, covalently incorporating methacrylated phenol red (MA-PR) for stable pH colorimetric sensing and integrating metal-free COF-102 as a photothermal therapeutic unit. Benefiting from its extended π-π conjugated framework and low thermal conductivity, COF-102 achieves efficient photothermal conversion without the need for metal ions or additional photothermal agents, thereby enhancing the biosafety of the system. Furthermore, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is introduced to analyze hydrogel color images, enabling accurate classification of wound status and supporting near-infrared photothermal intervention. The model is deployed on a mobile web application, facilitating convenient point-of-care analysis. In an infected wound animal model, the platform shows good therapeutic performance, reduces unnecessary heat exposure, and significantly promotes wound healing. Overall, this study establishes a point-of-care wound management strategy for photothermal therapy of chronic wounds.
zh_abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] 糖尿病伤口感染的非实时监测常导致治疗延误，加重组织损伤并影响愈合。为此，本研究开发了一种基于共价有机框架（COF）、由深度学习辅助的伤口管理平台，用于即时检测（point-of-care）pH 监测和光热治疗。该平台由多功能水凝胶构建，通过共价方式引入甲基丙烯酰化酚红（MA-PR）以实现稳定的 pH 比色传感，并整合无金属的 COF-102 作为光热治疗单元。得益于其扩展的 π-π 共轭框架和较低的热导率，COF-102 无需金属离子或额外的光热剂即可实现高效光热转换，从而提高了系统的生物安全性。此外，引入卷积神经网络（CNN）分析水凝胶颜色图像，可对伤口状态进行准确分类，并支持近红外光热干预。该模型部署于移动网页应用，便于进行即时检测分析。在感染伤口动物模型中，该平台显示出良好的治疗效果，减少了不必要的热暴露，并显著促进伤口愈合。总体而言，本研究建立了一种用于慢性伤口光热治疗的即时检测式伤口管理策略。

title: Death, Existentialism, and the Personalised Patient Preference Predictor.
zh_title: 死亡、存在主义与个性化患者偏好预测器
summary: 哲学伦理文章，基于克尔凯郭尔与海德格尔质疑微调LLM预测失能患者偏好（P4）的益处，认为其可能妨碍人们直面死亡。
key_points: P4指微调LLM预测失能患者偏好的设想技术
质疑其尊重自主、减轻负担等宣称益处
认为可能削弱患者与代理人面对死亡的能力
reason: 伦理观点文章，无实证数据，属常规观点档
abstract: [Bioethics] It has recently been proposed that fine-tuned large-language models (LLMs) could more accurately predict the preferences of incapacitated patients than surrogates. This hypothetical technology has been named the personalised patient preference predictor (P4). Advocates of the P4 claim that the P4 will not only more accurately predict patient preferences, but will better respect patient autonomy, facilitate the composition of advance directives, and reduce the emotional burden of surrogate decision-making. I challenge these purported benefits by arguing that the P4 would pose a substantive risk to our ability to meaningfully grapple with death. Drawing on the philosophies of Søren Kierkegaard and Martin Heidegger, I argue that adopting an existential attitude towards death is central to the pursuit of an ethical life. Implementation of the P4 risks inhibiting both patients and surrogates from adopting an existential attitude towards death, with deleterious consequences.
zh_abstract: [Bioethics] 最近有人提出，经过微调的大语言模型（LLM）可能比代理决策者更准确地预测失去行为能力患者的偏好。这一假想技术被称为个性化患者偏好预测器（personalised patient preference predictor，P4）。P4 的支持者声称，P4 不仅能更准确地预测患者偏好，还能更好地尊重患者自主权、便于预先指示的制定，并减轻代理决策的情感负担。我对这些所谓的益处提出质疑，认为 P4 会对我们切实面对死亡的能力构成实质性风险。借助索伦·克尔凯郭尔（Søren Kierkegaard）和马丁·海德格尔（Martin Heidegger）的哲学，我认为对死亡采取一种存在论态度是追求伦理生活的核心。P4 的应用可能会妨碍患者和代理决策者对死亡采取存在论态度，并带来有害后果。

abstract: [Pharmaceuticals (Basel, Switzerland)] Generative and predictive artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly increasing the number of molecular, structural, cellular, and therapeutic hypotheses that can be explored computationally. Experimental capacity, however, has not expanded at a comparable rate. The result is an evidence bottleneck, in which biological hypotheses are generated faster than they can be experimentally tested, reproduced, and translated. This mismatch is particularly consequential for pharmaceutical discovery, where computational predictions alone cannot establish biological function, mechanism, or therapeutic value. As the number of computationally generated hypotheses grows, the central challenge shifts from candidate generation to the prioritization of hypotheses for experimental validation. This evidence bottleneck represents a defining constraint of AI-enabled biological discovery. We examine how different biological claims, including structural, interaction, functional, mechanistic, and therapeutic claims, require distinct types and levels of evidence. We also address the cost and context-dependence of experimental validation. Furthermore, we discuss how information-guided experimental design and iterative model-experiment feedback can improve the allocation of limited experimental capacity. We propose an evidence-centric framework for drug discovery that extends the evaluation of generative models beyond their ability to generate or rank hypotheses. The framework emphasizes experimental testability, mechanistic understanding, reproducibility, and translation into actionable biological and therapeutic knowledge.
zh_abstract: [Pharmaceuticals (Basel, Switzerland)] 生成式和预测性人工智能（AI）正迅速增加可通过计算探索的分子、结构、细胞及治疗假说的数量。然而，实验能力的扩展速度并未与之相当。其结果是形成证据瓶颈，即生物学假说的产生速度快于其被实验检验、重复和转化的速度。这种不匹配对药物发现尤为重要，因为仅凭计算预测无法确立生物学功能、机制或治疗价值。随着计算生成的假说数量增加，核心挑战从候选假说的生成转向对假说进行优先排序以供实验验证。这一证据瓶颈是AI赋能的生物学发现的决定性制约因素。我们探讨了不同的生物学主张（包括结构、相互作用、功能、机制和治疗方面的主张）如何需要不同类型和水平的证据。我们还讨论了实验验证的成本及其对情境的依赖性。此外，我们讨论了以信息为导向的实验设计以及模型–实验的迭代反馈如何改善有限实验能力的分配。我们提出了一个以证据为中心的药物发现框架，将对生成模型的评价扩展到其生成或排序假说的能力之外。该框架强调实验可检验性、机制理解、可重复性，以及向可付诸行动的生物学和治疗知识的转化。
